method: Arithmetic component mean of 23 six-hourly archived DFO POPS STLE500 surface forecast fields, October 12 00:00 through October 17 12:00 UTC 2026. Daily 6,12,18 hour forecasts and preceding-day 24 hour forecast for 00 UTC. Requires all 23 samples. Distributor uos/vos retained as geographic east/north after independent narrow-channel alignment and STLE200 overlap audits reject an additional grid rotation. Generic x/y source labels do not conclusively document distributor preprocessing; orientation interpretation supported by those audits. Nearest native node resampling includes land nodes and maximum 425m distance, preserving coverage mask. No extrapolation or synthetic gap filling. Fixed sampled week-to-date mean, not climatology or direct observation.
